Overall, it was a horrible experience. I somehow managed to get discharged from there.

I strongly advise others to think twice before choosing this hospital.

This abrupt change felt shocking and made us question whether the issue could have been identified earlier or if it was merely a push for a more expensive procedure.

Additionally, the hospital's sonography machines are very old and unreliable, which added to our concerns during the pregnancy. The rooms and facilities were also very average, door not locking properly.
The only good thing about this hospital was the nursing staff, who were kind and professional throughout.

Overall, choosing this hospital was a big mistake. I would not recommend it to anyone, especially if you are looking for a normal delivery, as their initial promises from the doctors do not align with their final approach.
